scenes.text: Imagine standing in the absolute middle of a burning, empty desert with nothing but scorching sand for over two hundred and fifty miles in every single direction.
Right there, completely isolated, lived the historic Tree of Ténéré, a miraculous single acacia that survived the brutal Sahara by stretching its roots over a hundred feet underground to find water.
But in nineteen seventy-three, a drunk truck driver somehow managed to drive across hundreds of miles of flat, empty wasteland and crash directly into the only tree in sight.
It sounds like an impossible, bad joke, but this tragic accident actually happened, so do you think this was just terrible luck or destiny? Tell me in the comments and hit follow for more.
